🗺️ Browse📷 Scan

VKV gear inventory guide

Find: https://inv.kreweofvaporwave.com/ · Scan: https://inv.kreweofvaporwave.com/scan/

Add both to your home screen: in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Saves are live for everyone at once.

Find gear

  1. Open the Find address and type two or more letters of a name or ID in 🔍 Find gear. You see each match and where it is.
  2. Tap a match. A container opens to show what's inside. An item opens its container, outlined, with its details.
  3. To go back up, tap a step in 🏠 In › … or use Back.

Browse opens on In: the warehouse map. Out (gear that's out), Lost, Broken and Retired are listed under Elsewhere.

The name buttons under the map are the easiest thing to tap. The address bar always links to what's open, so you can copy it to share. Pointing your iPhone camera at a label's QR code opens that container.

Move gear in or out

Checking out and checking in are the same: put items into a bin and save.

  1. Open Scan. The first time, tap Allow for the camera.
  2. Scan the bin's label, or type its name. You see what's already inside.
  3. Scan or type each item. It appears under Adding. "(from X)" means saving moves it out of X.
  4. Tap Save. A green line lists what moved. A red line means nothing saved: tap Save again.

Nothing saves until you tap Save. Undo takes back your last step. ✕ next to the list closes it without saving.

To Do this
Send gear out with no bin Tap ＋ New bin, name it, add the gear, Save.
Return gear to the warehouse Type in, add the items, Save.
Mark gear lost, broken or retired Type lost, broken or retired, add the items, Save.
Log uncounted stuff (cords, tape) With the bin open, tap 📷 Photo, then Save.
Label one thing on its own Type its name, Make new, Just …, Save.
Log something with no label Type its name, then pick a match or Make new.
Scan an item before a bin Pick where it goes from the buttons Scan shows.
Scan a second bin Choose Put X into Y or Open X instead.

An unexpected ★ NEW is a typo: tap Undo and retype.

If you denied the camera, tap aA in the address bar, then Website Settings › Camera › Allow, and reload.

Print a label

With a bin or place open and nothing to save, the main button reads Print label; after a save the label prints anyway. On an iPhone, tap Share label, then choose the Phomemo app. On Android Chrome, Scan prints to the Phomemo printer directly.

Report a problem

Tap 🐞 Report, choose Something's broken or I have an idea, describe it, and tap Submit. If an item was open in Browse, the report names it.

Reports are public, so leave out anything personal. They become tasks for whoever looks after the app, but nobody's alerted right away. For anything urgent, email kreweofvaporwave@googlegroups.com (members only).

Fix names and details

Names, descriptions, categories, comments and stray rows are edited in the Google Sheet. Edits show in the app on the next load.

To move things on the map, tap ✏️ Edit map below it. Each change saves at once. ↶ Undo last move takes back the last one.

Good to know

  • Anyone with the link can edit. If something looks wrong, it may have been changed by accident.
  • A finished save can't be undone yet. Scan the items into the right place instead.
  • "HDMIs 1" and "HDMIs 2" share one ID. Fix one of them in the Sheet.
  • Stash and GADGET are miscellaneous bins.
  • Map positions inside a container are only a rough arrangement. Trust the list of names.
  • Browse and Scan need a signal.
